candidateDirections.name: Two-tier harness: hermetic component-seam overlay-loop test (default CI gate) + retained opt-in live-socket smoke
candidateDirections.summary: Tier 1 (always-on, hermetic): a cargo-test integration test that drives attach.rs::run_attach's full routing loop via injected channel seams - feed canned AppServerEvents into the tap, inject InboundEvents (mobile message/approve/deny/abort), assert outbound SessionEnvelopes on an observable sink and inbound ClientCommands on a fake AppServerRequestHandle; covers text-turn, approval approve+deny, abort, AEAD-drop, default-off; no model/socket/tunnel/auth. Tier 2 (opt-in #[ignore], nightly): promote the throwaway US-001 probe into a retained live_* test using the real packages/happy-server + a Rust mobile client over the real socket with real crypto-on-wire. Needs a small overlay-internal test seam (extract run_attach_core + a fake request-handle constructor).

candidateDirections.name: Real in-process codex app-server driven by a stubbed model (spike-gated higher-fidelity hermetic turn)
candidateDirections.summary: Drive a genuine codex turn through the real happy_tap tee with the model stubbed (canned Responses SSE via codex-core's test transport side-channel; never a real Copilot/Claude call). The only direction that exercises the actual app.rs tee + app_server.next_event ordering + real resolve/reject_server_request. Feasibility is uncertain (can codex-core/app-server be instantiated in-process with a canned transport from an overlay test crate, given the copilot provider is fail-closed on base_url?) so it is gated on a tiny spike that observes one genuinely tapped event with no new upstream seam. Effort L-XL; if the spike fails, stay at D-001.

candidateDirections.name: Full real-stack E2E (real happy-server + real codex + stub model) as the primary always-on gate
candidateDirections.summary: Maximalist: make the always-on CI gate a true wire-level E2E - real packages/happy-server + real codex subprocess (remote_session on, injected test creds, stub model) + Rust mobile client over the real socket. Most faithful, but requires node + a built happy-server + codex-core test harness all running hermetically inside cargo test --workspace on ubuntu+windows, which the invariant-check CI does not have today; heavy and flake-prone as a mandatory gate. Effort XL; better demoted to D-001's opt-in Tier 2.
